verdict.rationale: Hands-on community reports confirm that Vue's single-file components bundle template, logic and scoped CSS into encapsulated units. Its reactivity API manages per-component state, effects and computed values. Vue's own docs present it as a framework for building web UIs on a reactive rendering system. Community friction around composition (template DSL for complex trees, multi-level emit to pass data up) is a limitation, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: first-party documentation explicitly describing component encapsulation, local state and composition patterns; stronger evidence of smooth composition for complex UI trees and parent-child data flow.
